text:
carla: quick note- noticed billing counts incrementing for both org and project when router falls back. sample id: `req-3b9` shows org:+1 project:+1.
mike: ouch. is this from meter-lib increments at decode + post-resolution?
eden: likely. we used to count early for faster enforcement, then count again after resolution for attribution. that double-charges.
carla: proposal: emit header `X-Quota-Owner` once final, change meter-lib to prefer it for billing counters. keep old labels as `X-Auth-Lineage` for debug only.
ops_bot: deploy-bot: staging canary auth-router:v2-quota-header started 10:05 UTC.
console-team: heads-up: dashboards group by `owner` label; will need a small migration or alias layer so existing panels keep showing correct billing owner.
mike: plan: feature flag `quota_owner_header` in router + meter-lib. when flag on: meter uses header; if missing, fallback to legacy. emit metric `quota.owner_mismatch` when both differ.
eden: tests:
- fallback flow -> only canonical owner billed
- missing header -> legacy behavior
- mismatch increments metric
console-team: UX: add toggle "show attribution lineage" collapsed by default. do not surface high-cardinality tags in default views.
carla: I'll open INFRA-2301 with traces and small repro. tagging @mike for PR. :thumbsup:
